when: your team has taken dragon soul
asks: we have soul what now
we got soul how do we end
soul's ours what's next
do we wait for elder
say: Group and force Baron or their base while soul makes your fights stronger, or set up early for Elder when it's next.
more: Four elemental dragons give soul, and the dragon after that is Elder. They have to contest it, so be there first.
Soul pays in grouped fights. Force them where all five of you are together.
The usual throw from here is one player caught alone before the objective, so move as a group.
check: Whether Baron is alive, how long until Elder, and whether your team is together.
breaks: Wrong if their team is stronger late and gold is still close: do not wait for Elder. Use Baron to end sooner.
basis: rule

when: you are behind in level and are level 6 or higher
asks: warwick behind what do i do
i'm behind on warwick
how do i come back as warwick
warwick fell behind farm or gank
say: Farm until Blood Hunt shows a low enemy, then run them down, or hold Infinite Duress for whoever dives your carry.
more: Blood Hunt senses enemies below half health and speeds you toward them, so it points you at fights that are already half won.
Infinite Duress suppresses the first champion you collide with. That works as well from behind as from ahead.
Eternal Hunger heals you from your attacks once you are below half health, which keeps your clears going without recalls.
check: Whether the low enemy is under a tower or running toward teammates.
breaks: Wrong if the low enemy is retreating into their team: you arrive alone and behind. Let them go and keep clearing.
basis: kit:Warwick

when: you are behind in level and are level 6 or higher
asks: amumu behind what do i do
i'm behind on amumu
how do i help as amumu when behind
amumu no items what now
say: Save Curse of the Sad Mummy for two or more standing together at an objective, or Bandage Toss a lone target for your team.
more: Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns the enemies around you, and that does not depend on your items.
Bandage Toss stuns the target and pulls you to them, so only throw it when teammates are close enough to follow.
Cursed Touch makes enemies you attack take bonus true damage from magic damage, so fight next to your mages.
check: Whether your team is in range to follow, and how tightly they are standing.
breaks: Wrong if your team is not close: you pull yourself into them alone. Stay back and stun whoever comes for your carry.
basis: kit:Amumu

when: you have more kills than deaths
asks: kindred ahead what do i do
i'm fed on kindred how do i snowball
who do i mark as kindred
kindred ahead, marks or objectives
say: Keep completing Hunts on marked targets, each one is permanent, or play the next objective with Lamb's Respite ready.
more: Mark of the Kindred makes each completed Hunt a permanent upgrade to your basic abilities, and every four also add attack range.
A lead makes Hunts on enemy champions realistic. Mark the laner you can actually reach, not the one you wish you could.
Lamb's Respite stops anything inside the zone from dying, enemies included, so place it for your low teammates and not over theirs.
check: Where your mark is, and whether the lane it is in is pushed toward your side.
breaks: Wrong if chasing a mark means walking past their pushed lanes: skip it. Stacks are not worth handing over your bounty.
basis: kit:Kindred

when: your level is below their jungler's
asks: ivern behind what do i do
i'm behind on ivern
ivern got invaded now what
how do i help as ivern when behind
say: Stay beside your strongest laner with Triggerseed and Rootcaller, or set groves on your camps and come back when they've grown.
more: Ivern does not need gold to be useful. A shield, a root allies can dash to, and Daisy all work from behind.
Friend of the Forest means camps cost you a walk, not a fight, so you can set groves and spend the waiting time in a lane.
Daisy fights beside you, which adds a body for your team at objectives.
check: Which laner is doing the most damage, and whether their jungler has been seen at your groves.
breaks: Wrong if their jungler keeps taking your camps: stop setting groves on that side and live in the lane instead.
basis: kit:Ivern

when: you have more kills than deaths and are level 6 or higher
asks: hecarim ahead what do i do
i'm fed on hecarim how do i fight
hecarim fed, who do i charge
how do i snowball hecarim
say: Charge their back line with Onslaught of Shadows once your team's in range, or run down a side laner with Devastating Charge.
more: Onslaught of Shadows makes enemies near where you finish flee, which scatters a team that is standing together.
Warpath turns bonus move speed into attack damage, so your lead and your speed feed each other.
Spirit of Dread gives you resistances and heals you from damage nearby enemies take, so fight in the middle with your team hitting too.
check: Whether your team is close enough to follow, and who on their side still has crowd control.
breaks: Wrong if your team is too far to follow: you scatter them and then fight alone. Wait, or pick a lone target.
basis: kit:Hecarim

when: you are behind in level
asks: rammus behind what do i do
i'm behind on rammus
how do i help as rammus when behind
rammus no damage now what
say: Powerball to whoever threatens your carry and taunt them, or roll in to start only when your team is right behind you.
more: Frenzying Taunt forces a champion to attack you, and it needs no items to work.
Defensive Ball Curl greatly raises your armor and magic resist and returns damage to attackers, so taunt someone who relies on attacks.
Soaring Slam also knocks up enemies near the center if you cast it during Powerball.
check: Who on their team is going for your carry, and whether your team can follow a taunt.
breaks: Wrong if their damage is mostly from abilities at range: the taunt target barely hurts you but the rest do. Peel, do not dive.
basis: kit:Rammus

when: your team is behind in kills but equal or ahead in towers and dragons
asks: we're down kills are we losing
they have more kills is it bad
we keep dying but we have towers
are we behind
say: You're not really behind. Keep taking towers and objectives and skip fights for kills, or contest the next one early as five.
more: Kills are gold for single players. Towers and dragons are what open the map, and you are level or ahead there.
Their kills only become a lead if they turn them into something. Deny that by not dying before a spawn.
If one of them holds most of those kills, plan fights around where that player is.
check: Which of their players has the kills, and which objective is next.
breaks: Wrong if their kills have become finished items on a carry: respect it, and fight only near your towers until yours catch up.
